top_reviews.title: To big!
top_reviews.text:
I got the size it recommended for my daughter and they were way too big! They are super cute and sparkly though! We we’ll just save for a few more years and use them then! Seem like great quality and I love the handles!

When ordering I would probably go a size down!

top_reviews.title: Gorgeous rainboots for my 4-year-old
top_reviews.text: I got these Sporto Kids (Jazz) Glitter Rain Boots for my 4.5-year-old daughter in preparation for back-to-school. My daughter currently wears a Size 1, so I ordered a Size 2 thinking that these would be tight with socks. There's still a bit of room in the boots, so I recommend staying true to size. These boots are definitely made well and have a good tread underneath to prevent slipping on wet surfaces.

top_reviews.title: Cute glittery shoes.
top_reviews.text: I got these for my daughter because she loves pink and glitter so it was perfect combination.  They fit true to size and are comfortable and looks stylish.  She loves wearing them on rainy days.
